notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.30.5 (341589)
notes.content:
[p][i]Greetings, Adventurers! In our latest update, see what’s in store for the rest of [/i]Season of The Two Embers - Part 1[i], then celebrate and relax in turn with Days of Sunlight and Days of Moonlight. Plus, an all-new Radiance Event, updates to dye gathering, and more are coming your way too! [/i][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Season of The Two Embers - Part 1 Continues[/b][/h3][p]There’s plenty to still explore in the Season! Once you complete the fifth Seasonal Quest, new activities and mini-games become available in the season area. Chapters from the film can be rewatched at any time via meditation pads in the Cinema.
[/p][p align="justify"]A new themed memento will become available later in September: the [b]Projector of Memories.[/b] This prop allows the owner and nearby players to watch the four chapters of Part 1 of [i]Sky: The Two Embers[/i], plus a creator commentary, on a projector screen in any of the realms. Stay tuned for details about its release date![/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]The Projector of Memories video plays on a scheduled loop that includes [i]Sky: The Two Embers - Part 1[/i], the creator commentary, and concept art showcase. Playback repeats every 80 minutes starting at 00:00 (all times PDT, UTC -7).[/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]❗[b]Please note[/b] that the Projector of Memories prop uses the same video playback tech as the Cinema, which means that it has same platform technical limitations on certain devices. This means that [b]Projector of Memories video playback will not display on Nintendo Switch, Android 8, and Harmony OS on Huawei[/b]. [/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]Players on all devices will be able to see the prop itself and its glow effects. However, players on a platform that doesn’t support video playback will see a hint that says “This experience may be limited on your device” when standing near the prop and will not see any video projection. We apologize for any inconvenience these limitations may cause.[/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]This and other special themed items introduced in the 0.30.0 update will continue to be available in the in-game store until the Season ends on 23:59 October 5th.
[/p][h3][b]Days of Sunlight[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Quests, cameras, and curious spirits await you for an all-new Days of Sunlight! From September 1st through 21st, help a busy group of spirits catalogue the great outdoors, and you may find some delightful surprises along the way.[/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]Talk to the spirits in the event area to take on special event quests each day. Venture forth into the realms to find what they seek to add to their collection and earn Event Tickets in return![/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]Collect up to five Event Tickets each day from event quests and the event area. You can also gather 15 bonus Tickets through special photo quests.[/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]New cosmetics arriving with this year’s event include:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Sunlight Shawl: 22 Tickets[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Sunlight Wave Projector: 45 Tickets[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Sunlight Bonnet Bundle: $14.99 (all prices USD)[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Includes a sun dress outfit and jellyfish-inspired hat[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p align="justify"]Sandcastle Pieces: 5-8 Candles each[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Each of these seven different sandcastle pieces can be unlocked to build a sandcastle of your own design. Up to eight copies of each piece can be unlocked and then placed at once.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]Days of Summer items from previous years will be back (with the exception of the Bunny Accessory and Lantern Pack, which will be in Days of Moonlight), and items introduced for Event Tickets last year can be unlocked this year with Candles. Keep an eye out for trial spells for outfit items, too!

[/p][h3][b]Days of Moonlight[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]A silver moon rises over a serene landscape, calling Sky kids to share peaceful moments, memorable riddles, and perhaps even some…transformative moments.[/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]From September 29th through October 12th, follow the event guide Spirit to a starry-skied version of the Crescent Oasis. There you can share riddles with other players and try your hand at answering a few of your own. A nearby table will have snacks for you as well, which might just add a surprising twist to the Days of Moonlight experience.[/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]Collect up to five Event Tickets each day by reading riddles others have shared and gathering Event Ticket Light in the area. Up to 15 bonus Event Tickets are placed around the event space, too![/p][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]This year’s news Days of Moonlight items are:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Moonlight Banner:  18 Tickets[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Four of these banners are unlocked with 18 tickets. Four additional banners can be unlocked for five Candles each.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p align="justify"]Moonlight Tufted Tail Accessory: 42 Tickets[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Moonlight Basin: 75 Candles[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Moonlight Garland Cape: $14.99[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]Days of Moonlight items from previous years will be back, plus a few items originally introduced in other events: The Bunny Accessory and Lantern Pack from Days of Sunlight as well as the Bunny Slippers from Days of Style are permanently joining the Days of Moonlight lineup. Items offered for Event Tickets last year can be unlocked this year with regular Candles.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Radiance Event[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]A new type of event blooms in the realms! From October 13th through 26th, you’ll find that the Colored Dark Plants provide two types of Colored Light more frequently than normal, and across all realms, not just the realms their respective colors typically show up in—which will make it easier to stock up on those dyes more quickly!
[/p][h3][b]More Updates[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]We’ve made a number of other changes and improvements based on player feedback. These include:[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][list][*][p align="justify"]A new counter has opened in the Dye Workshop in Aviary Village! If you have at least started the first Season of Radiance quest, this counter will open for you to exchange a certain amount of dye each week in exchange for a different color of dye (or even a Candle).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p align="justify"]There are some updates to how Colored Light is gathered, too:[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Calling (shouting) no longer affects vines.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Vines can be burned from any point, but burn faster from the tips.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]The animation to gather the butterflies begins and ends more quickly.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]When tapping the prompt to collect the butterflies that emerge from the plants, the butterflies fly towards you faster and will continue to move towards you from longer distances, even after you’re no longer in the “collection” pose.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Once any single butterfly is called towards you, the rest will follow.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Butterflies on your hand provide a small call as visual feedback and will recharge your energy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
A new option in the Settings menu allows you to toggle off the game UI while recording video. If this toggle is enabled, you can then choose whether to display chat UI as well. (There are a handful of UI elements that will still be visible, such as text for hide and seek and the spell meter; these last few stragglers will be hidden by this feature in a future update.)[/p][p]
The in-game calendar has some new details: The daily timeline now displays the month, and calendar information now includes event duration. Plus, when selecting the map preview on the event image, the location for the event will be highlighted. A Thai translation is available too!
[/p][list][*][p align="justify"]You may notice a new option in the Account Info section of the Settings menu called Outfit QR Code. This is related to long-term plans to offer interactive avatar displays at real-world Sky events, so you may find this useful if you attend future Sky events in your area.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements and Bug Fixes in this update include:[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Items with a ✶ symbol next to it means that this is a fix for something that the player community reported to us. So thank you for letting us know about the bugs you’ve come across![/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b][u]Season of The Two Embers - Part 1[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p align="justify"]★ Fixed a bug causing soft-locks during the third Seasonal Quest.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Fixed an issue that allowed part of the third Seasonal Quest sequence to be skippable.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Fixed pathing issue with one of the guards during the third Seasonal Quest.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]★ Fixed issues related to multiplayer networking in the fourth Seasonal Quest.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Scarred Sentry won’t run through the camera during the cutscene for the fourth Seasonal Quest.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Manatee will appear as intended when teleporting to join a friend in the seasonal area.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]NPCs in the seasonal area won’t get stuck at and then teleport through obstacles.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="justify"][b][u]Gameplay[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p align="justify"]★ Fixed a bug preventing players in carry mode from collecting colored Light when in a chain of players.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]★ Mellow Musician was very focused on playing only one music sheet in Harmony Hall, but realized they should probably expand their repertoire—so now they’ll once again play along if a player selects a different music sheet to play together.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]★ Resolved an issue preventing players from receiving a Candle for reliving base game Spirits for the first time.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]★ Fixed a crash that could softlock players during the second Season of Revival Quest.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Resolved an issue preventing Jam Station patterns from saving in Shared Spaces.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="justify"][b][u]Cosmetics[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]★ Anniversary Popcorn and Clapboard prop won’t play the unequip animations when taking out either of these props while performing an emote.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p align="justify"]★ Fixed a bug that reduced the number of certain props that could be placed in a player’s Nest if they were purchased in the Nesting Workshop.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Fixed a number of hats that had clipping issues when equipped with the bald hairstyle.
[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"][b][u]General Fixes and Improvements[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p align="justify"]★ Fixed a bug that could cause uncollected motes of Light to become invisible to some players.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]★ Fixed the delay between the end of a cutscene and being able to light a Spirit husk when reliving a Spirit’s memory.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]★ Arrows to view multiple realm constellations in the Constellation pad won’t be displayed for new players who haven’t played those realms yet.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Restored a missing polygon under the stone steps leading to the jump off point from the Daylight Prairie social space.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]★ \[Android] For devices set to Japanese, all text displays properly when viewing the in-game description for the Season Pass.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]There was a huge party in Aviary, and the rock couldn't get enough! They attended every single event on the blue stage, and were inspired by all the different Sky kids who joined in to ask questions and talk about their experiences. Stories of friendship, hopes for the future, and silly moments all brought joy to the little stone. Maybe one day the rock would have their moment in the spotlight, too! They could tell everyone how amazing jellyfish are! In the wise words of a Sky kid in a stacked tophat, the rock wanted to be faumous! [/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="justify"]Please refer to this page for known issues ongoing or introduced with this patch: [url="https://thatgamecompany.helpshift.com/hc/en/17-sky-children-of-the-light/faq/1409-known-issues-patch-0-30-5-1756252345/"]Known Issues Patch 0.30.5[/url].
[/p][p align="justify"][i]As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback, and encourage you to join the community discussion on our official Discord server at [/i][url="https://discord.gg/thatskygame"]discord.gg/thatskygame[/url][i]![/i][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - July 18, 2025 - 0.30.0 (334880)
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/6363974c25d4fec9f17483a23d262c067b76d6eb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Hello, Skyfarers! The 0.30.0 update brings you some new adventures that we know you’ve all been waiting for—plus features, improvements, and bug fixes to make your journey through the skies a little brighter.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/3275a7396c87574e72998a48119287c8cf7c1dd7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Season of The Two Embers - Part 1[/b][/h3][p]Starting July 21st, a brand new adventure blends storytelling, gameplay, and cinema into an unforgettable experience.[/p][p][/p][p]The Season Guide in Aviary Village and Home will teleport you to the Cinema. This is where each Seasonal Quest becomes available as chapters of Sky’s long-awaited animation [i]Sky: The Two Embers - Part 1,[/i] available for everyone to watch in the Cinema. 
[/p][p]These quests transport you deeper into the world shown in [i]The Two Embers[/i]. Unlock cosmetics from this Season’s Spirits, each inspired by the story of [i]The Two Embers[/i]. Two Ultimate Gifts can be unlocked, and special themed mementos and outfit items will also be available in the in-game shop while the Season is active—some appearing during the first half of the Season, and others coming in the second half![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Hair accessories:[/p][list][*][p]Butterfly Blossom Memento: $2.99 (all prices USD)[/p][/*][*][p]Mini Manatee Accessory: $3.99 [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Manatee Plush: $6.99[/p][/*][*][p]Spirited Manatee Ensemble: $9.99[/p][list][*][p]Includes a tail and head accessory[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Vestige of Dark Dragons:  $11.99[/p][list][*][p]A more sinister tail and head accessory[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cloak of Darkness: $14.99
[/p][/*][/list][p]Season of The Two Embers - Part 1 runs from July 21st through October 5th (all times PDT, UTC -7).
[/p][p]For extra information, check out our blog post: [url="https://bit.ly/SeasonofTheTwoEmbers"]https://bit.ly/SeasonofTheTwoEmbers[/url][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/ddf56e63590514820c60122e0d83cc1cceaa502b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Sky’s Sixth Anniversary: The Main Event Arrives![/b][/h3][p]The Cinema is open and Sky Anniversary is officially in full swing! This is truly a gala event, with way too much happening to fit into the patch notes. [/p][p][/p][p]So here a few sample highlights:[/p][list][*][p]The Sky Creator Awards will be held [b]LIVE[/b] in the Cinema on[b] Friday August 15th at 18:30! [/b]The countdown video starts at 18:00, so come in early to catch some chill beats.[/p][/*][*][p]New weekly quests: Collect Event Tickets by watching each chapter of [i]Sky: The Two Embers - Part 1[/i] as they’re released.[/p][/*][*][p]New event items available to unlock or purchase, including a tuxedo and gown to wear to the Creator Awards in August.[/p][/*][*][p]Blue Carpet Interviews: Join TGC staff and special guests for a chance to be interviewed on a special mini stage in the Anniversary Aviary Village.[/p][/*][*][p]Cinema feature videos: Catch special videos, Creator Awards Showcases, and more on the Cinema’s silver screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Eye of Eden Run with the Devs: Join TGC staff as they lead (or stumble?) their way through Eye of Eden![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/e82783ec7f136c09adebca7070141e82786bdd0f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To see all the in-game events happening, and what time they start, be sure to check the in-game Calendar! Find it in the News section in the Settings menu. Keep an eye out for a News post with more details later on, too![/p][p][/p][p]The Anniversary items that were released at the start of the event in 0.29.5 will remain available through the end of the event. (However, as mentioned in the 0.29.5 patch notes, the TGC Wireframe Cape can be purchased in the TGC Office area after the event. This cape allows the owner and anyone they’re holding hands to teleport to the Anniversary area and play its activities year-round, with the exception of access to the TGC Office and Cinema programming.)
[/p][p]Several new items are joining the lineup with 0.30.0 for the rest of the Anniversary:[/p][list][*][p]Sky Balloon prop: 16 Event Tickets[/p][/*][*][p]Blue Carpet: 26 Event Tickets[/p][/*][*][p]Anniversary Suit: 66 Event Tickets[/p][/*][*][p]Balloon Arch prop: 20 Candles[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These items will be available [u][b]August 11th through 17th[/b][/u], just in time for the Creator Awards on August 15th:[/p][list][*][p]Anniversary Gown Ensemble: $9.99[/p][list][*][p]Includes a gown and shoes[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Anniversary Tuxedo Cape: $14.99[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Note for players on Switch and Android 8:[/p][p]Unfortunately, due to platform technical limitations, chapters of the animation and Cinema feature videos cannot be viewed on your devices. [/p][list][*][p]To complete the new weekly quests, you’ll only need to visit the Cinema. [/p][/*][*][p]To view each chapter of [i]Sky: The Two Embers - Part 1 [/i]as well as other video content in the Cinema, we recommend using a different device that supports these features in Sky. 
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]New Features & More Updates[/b]
[/h3][p][b]Speech to Chat[/b][/p][p]Transcribe your chat message on mobile and PC! Activate by tapping or clicking the microphone icon above the speech bubble icon in the lower left corner of your screen, or by tapping the T button on your keyboard.
[/p][p]Speech to Chat works for the language your device is configured to, though (much like human brains) it works best if you use just one language at a time.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/ccccc245337bb177138d900950715b245234c7a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Spotlight Tech Feature: Follow and Send Gifts to Performers[/b][/p][p]After Spotlight Tech was released, we saw a lot of player feedback asking for ways to better express appreciation for the person sharing something onstage, or to be able to see more of that person’s Shared Memories and other creations. So we’ve made something that allows you to do just that! [/p][p][/p][p]A new menu appears when watching performers that gives you the option to send a Heart to a performer or other on-stage player using Spotlight Tech, and to choose to “follow” them and see more of their Creations in the realms. 
[/p][p][b]More Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]A group of Spirits from various Seasons will appear for a special visit in one of the realms from August 18th through 31st.[/p][/*][*][p]It now costs one Candle to send a Friend Post recorded message instead of two. (Players will need to update to 0.30.0 in order to see the new price.)[/p][/*][*][p]The Sky Event Calendar is now out on ALL devices that support Sky, including consoles and PC. This is accessible in the calendar tab in the News section in the Settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Another batch of new Daily Quests have been added, so keep your eye out while playing through this update![/p][/*][*][p]The meditation area that was initially introduced last year as part of Sky Anniversary will remain in the game after the Sixth Anniversary event ends, accessible from the regular version of Aviary Village![/p][/*][*][p]The Collaboration Room has been moved from Vault of Knowledge to Aviary Village. Specifically, the entrance to the Cinema that you restored in 0.29.5 is now the entrance to the Collaboration Room. notes.title: Days of Nature: The Ocean Needs You Again
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/eb04b8959f5122f4bf488610c8dc05bc45c60d25.jpg[/img]

Days of Nature has returned to Sky, and the ocean and its beloved creatures are in trouble once more—sending a quiet plea for help that echoes across the waves.


It all begins high atop the mountains of the Sanctuary Islands, where something feels different this year. After you enjoy the beautiful views, you might notice the Elder Manta—a long time guardian of the sea—circling nearby. It seems even they can sense the unease below.

Darkness has disrupted the ecosystem, polluting the waters and endangering the birds, mantas, and manatees that call it home. Creatures are trapped in this growing threat. It’s a patient, gentle task to set them free—but once you do, they take flight, circling joyfully before guiding you toward others still in need of help.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/0258c3c549f27df9e4778ffec0842ccbe7bc19fb.jpg[/img]

The waters aren’t safe just yet, though. The Darkness doesn’t just linger—it notices you. It clings to you as you move, slowly draining the color from the world around you. Even the world’s light seems quieter, dimmed by something just beneath the surface.

And that presence is changing. Each week, something new stirs in the depths, drawn to the disturbed waters. Some are small and sneaky. Others…well, you’ll want to tread carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/c62cd53fc9b18ee787f7d477abffde6c77e5bd72.jpg[/img]

[h1]Five Years of Light[/h1]

Days of Nature has always been a time to reflect, reconnect, and give back. It’s about discovering how much light a single act of kindness can bring. And this year, your efforts can ripple beyond the game world.

Sky continues its partnership with [url=https://theoceancleanup.com/]The Ocean Cleanup[/url], a nonprofit organization dedicated to ridding the world’s oceans and rivers of plastic pollution. The majority of in-game items available for purchase during Days of Nature will support real-world cleanup efforts in oceans and waterways. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/7c6741ce3ba27b88530ca7bfa74c889d13336213.jpg[/img]

These charity items will be specially designated in the in-game shop, and a little more than half of the list price of these charity items sold will be donated. Of the remaining amount, 30% goes to platform fees (charged by app stores), and 20% supports development costs.

Since 2021, the Sky community has raised almost $2.5 million for this vital cause—proof that a little light can go a long way! That support has helped remove plastic waste from the Great Pacific Garbage Patch, contributed to river cleanup projects through The Ocean Cleanup’s Interceptor program, and supported the testing and operation of large-scale ocean cleanup systems like System 002. These efforts are already informing the next generation of solutions being developed today.

Learn more about the history of the partnership and its impact [url=https://www.thatskygame.com/givingback]here[/url].

notes.title: Chasing the Blue Bird: A New Season in Sky
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/58d3a5bf39adb7501855121535acfd8972ac998b.jpg[/img]

Hope is fragile. Sometimes, it feels just out of reach—something we chase but never quite grasp. In Season of the Blue Bird, beloved Spirits return to share more of their story—one inspired by Maurice Maeterlinck’s timeless play, [i]The Blue Bird[/i], about the search for happiness and the chance to mend what is broken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/2364148f9a4128e2266a171493145834701310c2.jpg[/img]

[h1]What does it take to heal a heart?[/h1]
A quiet sadness has settled over a young child. Heart heavy, no one seems to know how to lift the weight. But a wise grandparent remembers a story—an ancient legend of the Blue Bird, a creature said to hold the power to heal sorrow.

In this new Season, you’re called to help the child find the Blue Bird. But the path isn’t straightforward. To uncover the bird’s true nature, you’ll journey alongside the child’s family—each of them having seen the Blue Bird before—or so they thought. 

They’ll take you to places where they once searched for meaning, believing the bird might hold the answers they sought. With each encounter, you’re not just chasing a bird—you’re uncovering what it means to truly see someone’s pain and stand beside them in it.

As you piece together the family’s stories, you’ll begin to understand that the Blue Bird is more than a fleeting symbol of hope—it’s a reflection of something far more profound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/d003dda12fec0a36eadaeba7540b0dd7f6efbae7.jpg[/img]

[h1]A moment of transformation[/h1]
As the search for the Blue Bird draws to a close, what you find may not be what you expected. But in that final moment, something else begins to unfold.

As the saying goes, sometimes what we’re looking for has been with us all along. Where is joy truly found? What kinds of happiness are fleeting, and what kinds endure? The answers may not be clear, but that’s part of the wonder.

Each step of this journey is an invitation—to look closer, to listen deeper, and to discover that perhaps, the greatest treasures are the ones we least expect. The question is—will you recognize it when you see it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/8a1f1ac1d372e2f2f339dca0f50dccfc1fc990bc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Updating Sky’s Beta Program
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Providing the best experience for our players has always been our focus here at thatgamecompany, and we want to thank our beta testers who have helped us on this journey. We’re excited to share some changes in how we handle beta moving forward to further improve how we work together and build an even stronger connection with our testers. 

Sky has grown so much over the years. Our teams have tried to balance changes to the development and production process with the demands it all puts on the studio’s beta testing structure—which has been mostly unchanged since 2018—but it was clear that we needed to evolve the process to make improvements. 

Starting on March 20th, we’ll be restructuring our beta program to improve feedback collection, enhance security against hacked leaks, and create a more efficient testing process which will allow us to partner more closely with our testers. As part of this transition, on this day all existing beta access will be removed and beta accounts will be reset. 

Players interested in participating in the beta program can apply through an open application process, and we’ll select testers from the applicant pool when participants are needed. We’ll rotate new testing groups too, which will create opportunities for even more dynamic feedback from various perspectives as more people participate in testing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/0f43ff283344105749800cfd4c7aed389fea4420.jpg[/img]

[h1]Key Changes and What to Expect[/h1]
[list]
[*] New application process: Instead of first-come-first-served invite links, Sky players interested in helping to test can apply through a questionnaire—we’ll share the form soon! When new groups of testers are needed, applicants will be contacted directly.
[*] Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) required: Testers will need to sign an NDA, meaning no beta footage or content can be recorded or shared outside of designated private beta channels on Discord.
[*] Discord-focused testing community: Our official Sky server will be the center of feedback, conversation, and reporting for everyone participating in a round of testing.
[/list]

This was a tough decision, as we have relied on our entire beta community who has always been there for us. We wanted to address the ongoing concerns and take meaningful steps to create the best version of Sky with your valued feedback. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/d19b38fa289db3ac4eafd91d42926e4882989ec5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Why These Changes?[/h1]
This new approach allows us to:
[list]
[*] Gather more structured and more varied feedback
[*] Ensure greater security for in-development content
[*] Maintain higher testing standards for future updates
[/list]

[h1]Next Steps and Timeline[/h1]
Beta will be shut down on March 20th. Exact dates are subject to change, but we plan to share the beta testing sign-up form within the next few weeks. Our new beta program will reopen around the week of April 14th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/c76e4ef286164fc808a5c5f89bb616135d38636e.jpg[/img]

[h1]A Message to Our Community[/h1]
We deeply appreciate the passion and dedication of our players. While these adjustments will take some getting used to, we’re confident they will lead to a stronger game with smoother updates for everyone.

Hand in hand, we’re building a better Sky—and we look forward to collaborating with our testers to make that happen. Thank you for your continued support, and for flying in the skies with us together!

notes.title: Patch Notes - February 27, 2025 - 0.28.5 (313329 Steam)
notes.content:
[i]Greetings, Adventurers! Season of Radiance brings more updates as it approaches its colorful conclusion—the final Seasonal Quests, plus an expansion to dyeable items.

An adventure comes in the shape of an event: The brand new Days of Treasure beckons you to hidden rewards.

Then there’s the new Spotlight Tech feature, a Double Light Event, a special group of Spirits headed to the realms, and more—keep reading for the details![/i]

 

[h2]Season of Radiance Continues[/h2]
More colors are on their way to herald the second half of the Season! All the varieties of Colored Light become available with the remaining Seasonal Quests, and the Radiance Guide and their friends invite you to use the dyes you collect to add your own personal, and colorful, touch to your favorite items.

Once you complete all of the Seasonal Quests, the Radiance Guide offers the chance to unlock a new and uniquely shaped cape in exchange for Hearts. (This will remain available to unlock even after the Season ends on 23:59 Sunday April 6th—all times Pacific).

 

[h2]Dye-Related Updates, Too![/h2]

This update brings some improvements to how dyeing works:

[list]
[*] A number of hats as well as face, neck, and head accessories are dyeable now.
[*] The dye selection menu now has symbols associated with each color for easier use.
[*] Numbers were added to the dye button to correspond with the amount of dye needed to dye a region of an item.
[/list]
 

[h2]Days of Treasure: Prizes Await on the Horizon[/h2]
A mystical chart be showin' the path to secret loot! Sky’s newest event comes ashore from March 3rd through 16th for every adventurous Sky kid. Two teams of Spirits (who you may recognize from past Seasons) will appear in a different realm every day, each hoping that you will help them on their hunt for buried treasure. 

Teleport to the teams’ location from the guide Spirit in Aviary Village or Home, and then choose which team you’ll help that day. Take a look at their magical map for a clue for where your search will take you, borrow their shovel, and then set out on the search!

The Spirit teams are competing with each other to see which one will receive the most help from Sky kids. At the end of the event, the winning Spirit team will send a special thank you message (and reward) to all Sky kids’ inboxes, in gratitude for your support.

Gain up to five Event Tickets each day from Event Ticket Light rewarded when you discover the Treasure. There are also 15 specially shaped bonus Event Tickets that can be found throughout the event, several in each of the Days of Treasure locations.

Themed items for Days of Treasure include:

[list]
[*] Treasure Cavalier Boots: 30 Event Tickets
[*] Treasure Shovel: 30 Event Tickets
[*] Treasure Seeker's Bounty: $14.99 (all prices USD) - Includes an eye patch mask, outfit, and a black and white dye each
[*] Dye Blessing: 10 Event Tickets each (up to three blessings)
[/list]
Free trial spells are available for all items—find them near the Spirits and their map in their event area!

 

[h2]New Feature: Spotlight Tech![/h2]
A new feature makes its official premier: Spotlight Tech allows players to perform in front of an audience of other Sky kids, up to nearly 300 in the same server instance!

The spotlight shines in the Aviary concert hall, where this feature lets any player join a queue for their turn to perform a brief melody on the grand concert hall piano. No auditions necessary! Just be sure that you’ve finished the second Season of Duets quest from the Duets Guide in the concert hall.

In between melodies, or if you’d rather enjoy the music others share, there are plenty of seats for you and your fellow audience members to take it all in together.

Over the years, we’ve seen just how many memories players have created by sharing music with each other on instruments, from intricate arrangements to simple but heartfelt songs. We’re excited to see the performances you come up with!

 

[h2]Daylight Saving Time[/h2]
Daylight Saving Time takes effect at 2:00 am Pacific Time on [b]Sunday March 9th[/b], moving clocks ahead an hour. Time notation for events in Sky will change from UTC -8 to UTC -7. If your region does not observe this time change, after March 10th daily reset will occur an hour earlier for you.

Note that due to technical limitations affecting the servers, after reset on March 10th, clusters of Season Candles and Treasure Candles from March 9th will remain in their level for one additional hour, while the clusters of Season and Treasure Candles for the 10th spawn in their respective level. 

The total number of Season and Treasure Candles available in the game returns to normal at 1:00 am March 10th PDT. We appreciate your understanding.

 

[h2]Special Group of Visiting Spirits Arriving in April![/h2]

Six Spirits will pay Sky children a special visit in April! Mark your calendars for April 7th through 20th—and stay tuned for more announcements as the date approaches.

 

[h2]Some More Updates to Mention[/h2]
[list]
[*] From March 17th through 23rd, find four extra Seasonal Candle locations in the realms, and you’ll be able to gather an additional Seasonal Candle each day. There will also be double Treasure Candles scattered across two realms each day. Find all eight for a boost to your Candle run!

[*] Now if you add a chat message to your Emote Favorites menu, the language filter will be applied before it saves to the menu.

[*] If you’re reading the patch notes, you’re likely not a new player—but in case you find yourself guiding new friends through the skies, heads up that we’ve made improvements to the experience for players entering Sky for the first time. Some of these may also be visible even if you’re not new, such as:
[list][*] The Rejecting Voyager is placed outside of their now-former tunnel in Isle of Dawn, and the Constellation Gate there has been removed.
[*] If an emote or outfit item is still locked, hint text indicates what Spirit it’s from and how to acquire it.
[*] All outfits that can be unlocked can be previewed in the closet by all players.
[*] Updates to the Isle of Dawn cave intro sequence, including red Candle placement.
[/list][/list]
 

[h2]Improvements and Bug Fixes in this update include:[/h2]
[i]Items with a ✶ symbol next to it means that this is a fix for something that the player community reported to us. So thank you for letting us know about the bugs you’ve come across![/i]

 

[h3]Highlights[/h3]

[list]
[*] ✶ Fixed Colored Light butterflies being drawn away (or appearing to be drawn away) by deep calling.
[*] ✶ Resolved issues that could occur when using one-handed mode, such as inability to deep call, to open the Emote Favorites menu normally, or to interact with Friendship Menus.
[*] ✶ Missing Daily Quest Spirits have returned to their counter in Aviary Village.
[*] ✶ Elder mask eyes stay lit when the mask is broken. 
[*] Outfit items you do not own can now be previewed in the color dye station.
[*] ✶ Fixed an issue where butterflies would sometimes appear pitch black.
[/list]
 

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

[list]
[*] ✶ There are many wonders in Prairie Peaks, but underwater Shard Eruptions shouldn’t be one of them, so we fixed the Shard Eruption that was happening underwater in the river.
[*] ✶ Resolved some Message Shrines not working or allowing messages to be placed.
[*] ✶ Fixed error preventing completion of the fourth Season of Duets quest in the concert hall.
[*] ✶ To minimize disruption, Shared Spaces cannot be placed in the elevator area of the Eight Player Puzzle in Daylight Prairie.
[*] Fixed crashes when scanning the ThatSkyKid figurine STAR feature in Aviary Village.
[/list]
 

[h3]Cosmetics[/h3]

[list]
[*] ✶ Fixed animation error affecting the Sparrow Cape when using certain emotes.
[*] ✶ Fixed a texture error that could affect the Mischief Tufted Hair during certain movements.
[*] ✶ Fixed a graphics corruption when equipping the Style Wide-Leg Jeans.
[*] Outfit dye colors display correctly in areas where the ground shows reflections of avatars.
[*] Mural element props no longer appear extremely bright when placed in a Shared Space.
[*] Fixed small visual error causing the leaves on the Purple Tea Set pot to flicker.
[*] Hint when previewing closet items now says more clearly how to obtain the item.
[*] Avatar’s right arm won’t clip into capes while using the sassy and proud stances.
[/list]
 

[h3]General Fixes and Improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Traversal emote animations (like skipping) won’t break when previewing a Shared Memory you made using them.
[*] Fixed localization error in hint text that displayed when unsuccessfully attempting to send a Heart to someone through their Player Creation.
[*] Avatars won’t sometimes randomly change the direction they face when transitioning to a new area within a level.
[*] ✶ Avatar’s hands keep their proper shape no matter what when using the heart hands expression, instead of certain outfits causing their hands to look like an origami experiment gone terribly wrong.
[*] Looping emote animations are no longer interrupted by idle stretching animations when sitting.
[*] Spell icons on the lower left side of the screen can be properly interacted with after using a consumable spell. 
[*] ✶ Fixed formatting and navigation issues with the blocked players list when there are more than 48 blocked players.
[*] ✶ Seasonal Spirits in the Village of Dreams area no longer show the rainbow halo effect after completing their quests.
[*] ✶ UI elements no longer overlap when using the dance emote from the Festival Spin Dancer.
[*] Fixed rendering issue for flowers around the trio of statues in Sanctuary Islands and around the first stone arch along the path at the beginning of Hidden Forest.
[*] ✶ Fixed Spirit poses in the memory quest for the Shivering Trailblazer being in the wrong order.
[*] ✶ Holes in the wall are perfect for a spot for an incredible restaurant or cozy cafe, but not so much when it’s a place in Prairie Peaks that players can get stuck in, so we fixed that particular hole in the wall there.
[*] Fixed rippled water effect floating in the air in Prairie Peaks.
[*] Fixed odd UI behavior when interacting with the dye menu via trackpad. 
[*] Fixed certain cases where it was possible for a player to get stuck under a table, or under the table in the Dye Workshop.
[*] ✶ The Sky kid NPC in the Office has put their mask back on.
[*] ✶ Filled in a polygon that was missing backstage in the Village Theater area, and a hole on the mainstage itself that hapless players could easily fall through while wearing the chibi mask.
[*] Avatar animation won’t break when holding a fan prop and candle at the same time.
[*] The Sleepy Traveling Merchant’s rug no longer clips into the ground inside the Spell Shop in Aviary Village.
[*] Remembrance Guide's sash no longer clips with their body.
[*] ✶ Fixed crashes on mobile devices when using an instrument via an external keyboard.
[*] ✶ [Android] Mouse input won’t be registered as touch input when used on Android devices.
[*] [Android] Android devices now show the correct buttons for Bluetooth controllers.
[*] [Android] Text field UI properly displays when chatting on a Galaxy Note 10+ while using a Bluetooth keyboard.
[*] ✶ [iOS] Fixed crashes when the player uses the in-game recording on certain devices.
[*] ✶ [iOS] Images taken by the in-game screenshot on iPad will no longer be stretched or distorted when graphic settings are set to Letterbox Mode aspect ratio.
[*] ✶ [PC] Fixed emoji appearing as "??" when inputting from certain keyboards in Windows 10.
[*] [PC] Players on a high refresh monitor will no longer get stuck when trying to pass through the Spirit Gate to the Office area with the Office NPC.
[*] ✶ [PlayStation] Levels 3 and 4 Troupe Greeter emote won’t cause distorted sound when canceling the emote.
[/list]
 

Please refer to this page for known issues ongoing or introduced with this patch: [url=https://thatgamecompany.helpshift.com/hc/faq/1380-known-issues-patch-0-28-5/]Known Issues Patch 0.28.5[/url].

notes.title: A Look at Sky in 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/8e6385e69a07b94f3f56fe5cfc559fdf573435d8.jpg[/img]

We’ve kicked off a new year in Sky, which means another year growing and soaring together! You, the community, have helped Sky reach new heights, and all of us here at the studio are ready to make 2025 the most memorable yet. There’s more headed your way than we can squeeze into a blog post, so here’s a sample of what we’re working on for the months ahead!



[h2]Connecting with Friends & Sharing Expressions[/h2]
We all shine brighter when our connections are stronger and when we have more ways to express ourselves.

New features and improvements are on their way so that you and your friends can enjoy even better ways to connect and express yourselves:

[list]
[*] [b]Spotlight Tech:[/b] This new feature coming to the concert hall will allow any player to share a musical performance with up to nearly 300 others across server instances.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/f21ba703a59b011b515c4b8034fc80df893eb9d4.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Sending offline Memories through the Friendship Constellation:[/b] Stay in touch with friends even if you aren’t online at the same time—and in true Sky style, your options aren’t limited to only the written word.
[*] [b]Making Shared Memories with friends:[/b] The team is creating ways for multiple players to record a Shared Memory together.
[*] [b]Updates to the Friendship Tree:[/b] We’re making it easier to progress through the Friendship Tree with other players you meet, with more abilities lower in the Friendship Tree so that the tree isn’t taller, but wider.
[*] [b]Nest capacity upgrades:[/b] For when you need extra plushies and plants and decorations alongside your latest prop sculpture.
[*] [b]More improvements to dyeing:[/b] We’ll be refining the dye feature based on your feedback and expanding categories of items that can be dyed!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/d293cd7c100909032f4c46540a4bec2698c9ca9b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Events, Seasons, Parties, and More![/h2]
Sky will host a huge range of events this year, with new experiences, returning favorites, and stories that broaden the story of Sky and beyond. Mark your calendars for these: The AURORA Concert is coming back in June for a special celebration. 

Plus, Sky’s 6th Anniversary is bringing a spectacular birthday party to everyone in July, with a grand festival featuring players themselves!

To say more would spoil the surprise, so we’ll just say that we’re very, [i]very[/i] excited for what’s in store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/70ed033daffe7849b85cc14b76e2709f8995d63d.jpg[/img]

Our Seasons will bring inspiring stories that look at the heart of what it means to be a Child of the Light. Season of Radiance has started with a burst of color, and it’s opening up countless possibilities to add your creative touch to your avatar. 

And later this year, beloved Spirits seek your help as they search for something that’s missing, and of course, get ready to step into the kingdom’s lore with a Season based on the [i]Sky: The Two Embers[/i] animation project!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/e351fb32546cbfd06fa88fbea853695866cbf8b5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Building Friendships With Spirits[/h2]
This year it’s time for big updates that will make it more intuitive and rewarding to build your relationships with the Spirits you meet!

2025 will have the first major improvements to relationships with Spirits. This goes way beyond giving Candles to a Spirit to unlock a new pair of pants. Like other relationships, this will be built on sharing activities and moments together. Spirits’ Friendship Trees will change and expand to reflect these new capabilities, and you can experience new parts of their stories, too.

Stay tuned for announcements on this big project!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/281e84898d3825c198e6aa6101e2943227474ca0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features and More to Feel At Home in Sky[/h2]
Sky is a place where you can feel at home, be creative, and find others to share your light with. These are just a few more projects that we’re planning to make your time in the realms even more memorable.

[list]
[*] [b]Meet and play with TGC devs in Sky:[/b] Coming soon, this will be a special way to play and interact with members of the studio directly in Sky. (And oh yes, there will be Eden runs.)
[*] [b]Optimizing the game loading and installation experience:[/b] A shorter wait until you can start flying in the skies!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/06600fcff0221321153dcaaa31d327180bc08527.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Music sheet revamp:[/b] Music is at the heart of so many Sky memories, and we want to make music sheets more enjoyable for everyone to use and play.
[*] [b]Jam Station:[/b] Improvements are on the way, like the ability to save and re-use the sequences you create.
[*] [b]More diverse ways to get Light:[/b] There are music sheet challenges, the table in the Elevated Clearing, the geyser and turtle in Sanctuary Islands, and more in addition to candle running, but we know there are even more possibilities to add variety and accommodate different play styles.
[*] [b]Continuing to knock back bugs:[/b] We’re focused on reducing incidents as well as bugs, especially the ones you report to us—so thank you for sending those bug reports in!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/18a3f9eda1e1636ffd9f0b32a9a87e84b7518832.jpg[/img]

[h2]Flying High Together[/h2]
In a nutshell: There’s going to be a [i]lot[/i] to look forward to! Many of these projects are still work-in-progress, so details, content, and timelines may change during development—but a little sneak peek won’t hurt in the meantime!

More improvements, new adventures, delightful surprises—you, the Sky community, have made it possible. We can’t wait to share everything in the months ahead. For now, be sure to stay tuned to our news for future announcements. And until then, we’ll see you in the skies!

notes.title: A Bounty Awaits in Days of Treasure
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/bdc1c470f2c32f304dc0eca6d0e43f590f08cc19.jpg[/img]

Ahoy, ye buccaneers! Winds of fortune carry whispers of a grand tale of lost riches buried beneath the stars. And ye, brave Skyfarers, are just the crew to claim it! Welcome to Days of Treasure, where maps be mysterious, shovels be plenty, and bounty be ripe for the plunderin’!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/b892ccf529974eb910b5d6cea408eca50cef9b32.jpg[/img]

[h2]X Marks the Fun![/h2]
From March 3rd PST (UTC -8) through March 16th PDT (UTC -7), mind your sea legs and gather 'round, for adventure calls in the land of the seven realms!

A series of enchanted maps have drifted into the realms of Sky, leading to troves of hidden wonders. But beware, for the sands of time slip swiftly through the glass, and once the map’s magic fades, so too will the treasures! Aye, ye must be swift, sharp, and ready to heave ho!

Each day, two daring teams of Spirits set sail—er, set forth—on a grand treasure hunt, each eager to uncover the loot before their rivals. The noble Scouts seek fortune with keen eyes and steady hands, while the cunning Scavengers rely on wits and wild instincts. But which crew will chart the course to victory? That, me hearties, be up to ye!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/48ce58cd173268b52277444b2e493efcfc4376ec.jpg[/img]

[b]How to Join the Hunt![/b]

[list]
[*] Choose yer crew! Will ye sail with the Scouts one day and switch to the Scavengers the next? The choice be yours!
[*] Heed the map’s clues—no easy echoes to guide ye this time! Keep yer eyes peeled for a flag marking the spot.
[*] Grab a shovel and dig, dig, dig! The deeper ye delve, the greater the glory!
[*] Check the signboards in each location to spy which team be winnin’ the favor o’ the Skyfarers.
[/list]

When the final bell tolls, all shall receive a prize sent as a message to ye adventurers, based on which crew rallied the most loyal hands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/4af9b9c925fb7fe566cf2e669cdeb9f76f8fb8b4.jpg[/img]

So hoist yer Spirits high, sharpen yer wits, and let the hunt begin! Riches, rivalry, and revelry await, but tarry not—the magic won’t last forever!

notes.title: Days of Fortune 2025: Games, Friends, and Fireworks!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/cdb90a5efb389375336953d0e4846cf1fb113162.jpg[/img]

The start of 2025 in Sky needs a proper celebration. New games, familiar faces, and the best dance track in the realms—the Spirits and a friendly stone dragon are getting everything ready for this year’s Days of Fortune!

Starting on January 27th PST (UTC -8), the event guide and a host of Spirits will be waiting for you to join them in Valley of Triumph to get the party started. Talk to the guide Spirit near the event announcement board in Aviary Village (or in Home too) to teleport to where all the fun is!

If you need a bit of a break from all the action, relax under the falling snow in the social hub at the beginning of Valley of Triumph. The snow there grants social Light, and it’s the perfect place to play music—in fact, our top 2025 song recommendation is the brand new Dragon Dance music sheet, which the Spirits have prepared this year just for Sky kids!

notes.title: Patch Notes - January 16, 2025 - 0.28.0 (308028 Steam)
notes.content:
[i]Greetings, Adventurers! We’re starting 2025 with all kinds of updates for you—Season of Radiance kicks off this month, and it brings a brand new dyeing feature for you to customize cosmetics with new color designs.

Days and Fortune and Days of Love bring new twists to familiar favorites, Aviary Village has an announcement board to keep track of events (among other improvements), and there are some other updates too. 

Plus, mark your calendars for Friday the 17th—we’ll have a dress rehearsal in the Aviary Village concert hall to stress test an upcoming feature![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/d7695a0cc1cad8bb6460175e2fad7e93af52879d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Season of Radiance[/h2]
A world of color awaits you! Sky’s next Season introduces a feature that many players have been requesting: dyes! The Season of Radiance Guide welcomes you to Aviary Village’s new Dye Workshop, and through Seasonal Quests they’ll teach you about colored Light that can be gathered in the realms, and how you can use it to forge dyes to customize the colors of your outfits.

Three Spirits who you may recognize from Sky’s earliest Season will return, too! These Season of Gratitude Spirits come back to share in Sky kids’ discoveries, and this time, they’re bringing three new expressions, not to mention a variety of capes, outfits, instruments and more—and just about everything can be dyed!

The Radiance Guide offers two Ultimate Gifts for Season Pass holders to unlock while the Season is active. They’ll also bring a uniquely shaped cape which can be unlocked with Hearts even after the Season ends—a memento to mark the opening of the Dye Workshop.

Season of Radiance begins January 20th and runs through April 6th (all times Pacific). Content is accessible to all players who have progressed to at least the third quest from the Hopeful Steward.


[h2]New Feature: Dyeing Cosmetics[/h2]
Transform your ensemble into unique creations! Over the course of Season of Radiance, eight different base colors will become available to gather from special Dark Plants in the realms—some colors will be more common than others. Use these base colors as their own dye, or mix them to create a total of over 70 colors!
[list]
[*] In 0.28.0, most capes, masks, and outfits (e.g. pants, dresses, tunics) have dyeable areas; items in other categories, such as head and neck accessories, are planned to become dyeable in 0.28.5. Some cosmetics are not dyeable—for example, hair color, Season pendants, collaboration items, and so on.
[*] You can preview color combinations before dyeing a cosmetic.
[*] Up to two different dyed versions of an item can be saved for you to wear as “Outfit Styles,” in addition to the original version.
[*] Some of the seasonal spells in the Radiance Spirits’ Friendship Trees will give dye.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/47f3884adb6ceacb18c7674979e4b589d4ad886a.png[/img]

[h2]Days of Fortune[/h2]
Let the biggest reunion party of the year begin! From January 27th through February 9th, celebrate with Spirits in the Valley of Triumph, play minigames with friends, and dance to the best dance track this side of Eye of Eden.

Talk to the Event Guide in Aviary Village or Home to teleport to the center of the action in Valley of Triumph. That’s where you’ll find a new minigame waiting for you in the ice rink. You’ll also find some familiar Spirits joining in the celebration there, so be sure to say hello!

A felicitous dragon friend returns to share Light, and they’ll be floating in the air for you regardless of what time you visit them. You’ll be able to transform into a dragon chain with fellow Sky kids once again, and yes, the Secret Area accessible from the ground floor of Vault of Knowledge will be open to all. 

The Fortune Gift Envelope will be back as well. This will be in the Friendship Trees of friends with whom you’ve unlocked the carry (piggyback) interaction and allows you to use 14 Candles to gift 5 Hearts. The Fortune Gift Envelope can be given once a day per person, like regular Heart gifts.

([b]Note:[/b] The Fortune Gift Envelope feature requires manual enabling, which means it will become available at [u]approximately[/u] 00:00 on the day the event begins until [u]approximately[/u] 23:59 the day it ends. Thank you for your understanding!)

[u]Event Tickets[/u]
Five coin-shaped Event Tickets (previously referred to as event currency) can be forged each day by playing the new minigame. There are also 15 one-time bonus Tickets that can be gathered throughout the event!

[u]New Items[/u]
New cosmetics are available for IGC (in-game currency) and for purchase. Plus, three red and gold themed props can be unlocked for regular Candles, and once the event ends, those props will be added to the Nesting Workshop rotation to unlock later in the year.
[list]
[*] Dragon Dance music sheet: 8 Event Tickets
[*] Red Dye Blessing: 10 Event Tickets
[*] Fortune Snake Mask: 14 Event Tickets
[*] Fortune Snake Pants: 36 Event Tickets
[*] Fortune Vertical Poster Prop: 5 Candles
[*] Fortune Candle Flags Prop: 10 Candles
[*] Fortune Plant Prop: 20 Candles
[*] Fortune Hand Fan: $4.99
[*] Fortune Snake Coif and Cloak: $19.99 - [i]Includes a snake-themed hairstyle and cape[/i]
[/list]


For details on returning Days of Fortune items, please refer to patch notes from previous years. As for items originally introduced for Event Tickets, the Fortune Dragon Mask can be unlocked for 57 Candles, and the Fortune Drum for 36 Hearts. Other than the three new props, free spells for new and returning items can be found in the event area.

Days of Fortune is available to all players who have at least started the third quest from the Hopeful Steward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/febf6d96aa36d028c8ba37387067002090031c6b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Days of Love[/h2]
Celebrate all the different connections at the heart of Sky, and beyond—Days of Love arrives from February 10th through 23rd.

Check with the Event Guide in Aviary Village or Home to teleport to where the event unfolds: the Jellyfish Cove area in Starlight Desert. That’s where a strange crystal formation has appeared from meteor showers, glowing mysteriously in response to emotes. Work together with other Sky kids to discover the secrets hidden within these shimmering shards!

[u]Event Tickets[/u]
Forge four Event Tickets each day by participating in this year’s new event activity. There will also be 15 one-time bonus Event Tickets hidden in the area that you can find throughout the event.

[u]New Items[/u]
New cosmetics are available for IGC (in-game currency) and for purchase, and this year’s new IGC items can be unlocked with Event Tickets: 
[list]
[*] Days of Love Violet Crystal Prop: 14 Event Tickets - [i]This prop glows when other Sky kids are nearby, or when someone nearby uses a friendship interaction expression.[/i]
[*] Days of Love Braids: 35 Event Tickets
[*] Days of Love Amethyst Accessory: $2.99 - [i]Like the Violet Crystal Prop, this hair accessory glows when other Sky kids are nearby, or when someone nearby uses a friendship interaction expression.[/i]
[*] Days of Love Amethyst-Tipped Tails hairstyle: $6.99
[/list]


For details on returning items, please refer to patch notes from previous years. As for Event Ticket items introduced last year, Love Heart Beret can be unlocked for 45 Candles, the Love Heart Plushie for 12 Hearts, and the Days of Love music sheet for 15 Candles. Free spells for new and returning items can be found in the event area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/e9bfccf9c6ada7f0d029950a8b7a5d37e43db60b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Join Us to Stress Test an Upcoming Feature![/h2]
[b][Edit 2025.1.17] This test has been postponed until a later date. Stay tuned to our social channels for future announcements![/b]
If you saw our Community Concert during the 5th Anniversary last year, you might remember the special limited feature that allowed performers to share their music performances with other players across servers when Festival Tech was active…

And perhaps you’ve wondered what we have in store for the Aviary Village concert hall since Season of Duets wrapped up…

One of our projects is an upcoming feature which allows players to enter a queue in the concert hall to share a brief musical performance on stage for the rest of the concert hall, for audiences anywhere from a couple dozen to a couple hundred people. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/456b4a2aee0e078d513123e0529003a2bd7ef5af.jpg[/img]

Some parts of this upcoming feature need to be verified in the live version of the game, similar to how we had a dress rehearsal test before the AURORA concert launch. So before we officially launch this feature, we’re inviting everyone to be part of dress rehearsal stress tests in the concert hall!

[b]We’ll temporarily enable this feature in the concert hall from [u]10:00 am Friday January 17th to 10:00 am Tuesday January 21st PST[/u] (UTC -8) for this stress test![/b] If you’ve completed the 2nd quest from Season of Duets, you can participate in two ways:
[list]
[*] Join the queue in the concert hall to perform a short song—all ability levels welcome! 
[*] Join the audience to listen to your fellow Sky kids’ melodies.
[/list]
The data we get from this will be super helpful to work out bugs and potential surprises on the backend, so thank you in advance if you choose to join. Otherwise, stay tuned for more news about this feature in future updates!



[h2]Aviary Village Updates: Event Announcement Board and More[/h2]
The construction crew has been at work in Aviary Village! You’ll notice a few changes in the area:
[list]
[*] There’s a new announcement board in the spot where the Event Shop entrance used to be. When an event is active, it will tell you how many days are left. If an event is not active, it will count down the days until the next event begins.
[*] Event Guide Spirits will appear near the event announcement board when their event is active. They’ll offer the option to teleport to their event area, and once you’re in that area, you can check with Spirits and such there for event items. 
[*] In the plaza at the entrance of Aviary Village, the decorative pole has been relocated, and in its place is a Constellation Table where you can view your friends’ stars.
[/list]



[h2]Even More Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] As promised in our last patch update, the in-game News feed is now available for players on Switch, Playstation 4/5, PC, and Steam Deck. This means players on all platforms can easily access critical information about in-game events, patch notes, and bug fixes. A few additional notes:
[list]
[*] For non-mobile platforms, we recommend using the QR code provided in-game for the best browsing experience.
[*] On Steam Deck, controller/gamepad support isn’t officially supported when browsing the News feed. Players will be prompted to use touchscreen controls to avoid potential audio issues. We’re still looking into a longer-term fix with Valve regarding supporting controller/gamepad navigation!
[*] Players on older or less powerful mobile devices, particularly iOS, may experience some performance issues when accessing the News feature.
[/list]
[*] Based on player feedback, we’re working on some updates to outfits with the longer term goal of making it easier to select shoes for certain outfits. This may happen gradually, but in 0.28.0 you’ll see some changes such as a new tab in the outfits closet for onesies, i.e. outfits where shoes are a set part of the ensemble.
[*] If you’ve set your game to start in your Nest, the game login sequence will load directly into your Nest, instead of transitioning through cutscenes from Home and Aviary Village.
[*] We’ve increased the max length of Shared Memory recordings from 30 seconds to 60 seconds! 
[/list]


[h2]Improvements and Bug Fixes in this update include:[/h2]
Items with a ✶ symbol next to it means that this is a fix for something that the player community reported to us. So thank you for letting us know about the bugs you’ve come across!


[u][b]Highlights[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Jam Station: Instruments that are categorized as placeables, like Duets pianos, are now a sound option.
[*] ✶ Fixed sustained instruments cutting off abruptly when played rapidly.
[*] Added a closet in the concert hall.
[*] ✶ Fixed a bug that could get a player stuck in the Trial of Air if they were handholding and then fell off a platform.
[*] Increased the maximum amount of medium and large items that can be placed in a Shared Space.
[/list]


[u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] ✶ Increased max polyphony possible for instruments. 
[*] Resolution that should fix a bug that was preventing completion of meditation Daily Quests.
[*] Don’s Memory Spirit in the Office can be completed properly again.
[*] Fixed an issue that could lead to a player becoming softlocked when reliving a Spirit’s memory.
[*] Fixed some bugs with the beacon icon/signal, which could get stuck in certain cases such as transitioning between parts of Hidden Forest, skipping the bell tower sequence in the Village area of Daylight Prairie, or using the Return Shrine to go back to the Graveyard area of Golden Wasteland.
[*] Players in their own Nest are able to properly join a friend in their Nest.
[*] ✶ Players can properly collect Light fragments during the Leaping Dancer’s memory quest. 
[*] ✶ Fixed a bug preventing players from interacting with friends or Spirits they summon from the Constellation after being in certain levels.
[*] ✶ Props can no longer be placed on top of the Constellation Table (and thus blocking it) near the realm portals in Aviary Village.
[*] [iOS] Fixed a significant drop in framerate that could occur and cause a progression break in the 6th Storybook Quest in Season of Moomin.
[*] ✶ Fixed handhold and carry breaking when using the Cave of Prophecy STAR pin. 
[*] ✶ Fixed an issue where handholding a friend prevented a player from leaving the Windpaths via tunnels to other levels.
[/list]


[u][b]Cosmetics[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] On the tier 2 teal cape, increased the contrast between the main cape color and the border color.
[*] Fixed an issue with props that could cause disruption to player movement in certain cases.
[*] ✶ Color Bubble machine prop reacts as intended to player’s cape color.
[*] Due to a bug, if a player had multiples of an item unlocked from the Nesting Workshop and placed them in their Nest, visiting friends could only see one of them. Now, each duplicate item is properly visible.
[*] ✶ Avatar’s legs won’t appear stiff and unnatural when wearing shoes.
[*] When using the Wonderland Cafe Corridor prop, other players will shrink down as intended when entering its door.
[/list]

[u][b]General Fixes and Improvements[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] ✶ Knees will no longer bend during avatar flight animation.
[*] In the Settings menu, the label for the “Home” button is updated to “Portals.”
[*] ✶ You can once again trigger a “trip and fall” animation while falling in motion.
[*] ✶ When teleporting to the SkyFest Aviary Village using the SkyFest Wireframe Cape, the parade performers now walk their full parade route instead of causing a supernatural Spirit traffic jam.
[*] ✶ Fixed a bug that caused markers for Seasonal Spirits to appear on maps for new players who hadn’t yet been through Eye of Eden.
[*] ✶ [PC] Resolved a crash that could happen when typing text into a field, then inserting an emoji symbol between text characters.
[*] Fixes for bugs related to Player Creations:
[list]
[*] Viewing a Shared Memory of yourself holding a plushie prop will no longer cause a crash.
[*] ✶ We have (re)solved the mystery of props that would inexplicably disappear from some players’ Shared Spaces, so those should no longer vanish into thin air.
[*] Fixed sustained notes playing infinitely after playing a Shared Memory in Aviary Village if the Memory had an instrument playing a sustained note.
[*] ✶ Fixed a bug with notifications that said a Shared Memory had been liked, regardless of what kind of Player Creation had actually been liked.
[*] ✶ “More” button displays correctly when more than 12 comments are posted to a Player Creation.
[/list]
[*] ✶ No more surprise teleports to Aviary Village when positioning your Sky kid behind your Nest’s edit crystal.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed more props to be placed in a Nest than there was space for.
[*] Props in your inventory won’t be greyed out before Nest capacity is almost full.
[*] While viewing a friend’s star, the pencil icon will no longer disappear when displaying their name when it has over a certain number of characters.
[*] UI & interacting buttons from the environment will no longer go missing when the player transitions levels while News is open. 
[*] Fixed duplicate prop icons that could appear briefly when cancelling edit in the Emote Favorites menu.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing players from scrolling through the gameplay tips while using a controller.
[*] ✶ Fixed different fonts being used in chat text vs. Player Creation text when device is set to Japanese
[*] We’re not sure how it would make sense to use the handstand emote while swimming… But players who had been doing that will now find that their Sky kid won’t be subjected to an odd animation in the process. Well, more odd than doing a handstand while swimming, at any rate. 
[*] Fixed animation bugs that could affect the somersault emote in certain cases.
[*] Fixed animation error causing avatars to overlap when a player accepted the carry interaction from a friend.
[*] Resolved weird avatar twisting during carryball Spirit memory quests.
[*] Various fixes for various Season of Moomin quests:
[list]
[*] Fixed crashes that could happen when teleporting to the Moomin Storybook area from the Moomin Guide’s Friendship Tree.
[*] Fixed a crash that could happen when teleporting back to the first or sixth Season of Moomin quests.
[*] ✶ Improved Spanish localization for the first Season of Moomin quest title.
[*] ✶ Fixed a German localization error during the first Season of Moomin Quest.
[*] Fixed a bug in the fifth Moomin Seasonal quest that could turn a player invisible.
[*] Fixed bug that could cause soft locks during the fifth Moomin Storybook Quest.
[*] Accessing the fifth Moomin Storybook quest won’t return player to the sixth Storybook quest.
[*] Fixed bugged audio of wind blowing during the sixth Moomin Seasonal Quest.
[*] Fixed part of the credits text after the sixth Moomin Storybook quest being cut off when device language is set to Japanese.
[/list]
[*] ✶ If a player scans a STAR pin that another player owns, the pin no longer erroneously indicates that a friend request can be sent.
[*] ✶ Took avatars to the chiropractor so that their spines will no longer bend inward in certain sitting positions.
[*] Fixed an issue for mobile players using controllers that could cause their avatar to keep moving if the player opened the News feature while moving.
[*] While searching for more jellyfish to befriend, the rock spotted a very curious creature! Was that...a crabbit? After following the crabbit, the rock discovered a giant room full of all kinds of treasures: books, mushrooms, and even a wonderful tea party with friends! The rock felt like a tiny pebble in comparison to the huge space, and spent days wandering, meeting new creatures, and appreciating the magic their new crabbit pal had introduced them to.
[/list]



Please refer to this page for known issues ongoing or introduced with this patch: [url=https://thatgamecompany.helpshift.com/hc/faq/1372-known-issues-patch-0-28-0/]Known Issues Patch 0.28.0[/url].


As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback, and encourage you to join the community discussion on our official Discord server at [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/thatskygame]discord.gg/thatskygame[/url]!

notes.title: A World of Color Awaits in Season of Radiance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/afad2816d548d72900a9ceb20c8e25bb82394eae.jpg[/img]

The Light in Sky bursts into a spectrum of color when Season of Radiance arrives! This Season delivers an eagerly anticipated feature for Sky kids to unleash their creativity and playfulness, and from outfits to Spirits themselves, even the familiar becomes new again.


[h2]First Stop: The Dye Workshop[/h2]
The Season begins on January 20th PST (UTC -8) with the arrival of the Radiance Guide. Follow them to the new Dye Workshop in Aviary Village, where they’ll teach you everything you need to know about using dyes in Sky. Naturally you’ll learn how to dye items from your closet—and you’ll also find out where to find dyes, too.

That’s because Season of Radiance is experienced throughout the realms of Sky. A new type of Dark Plant will be found sprouting in the kingdom. Venture forth with friends to explore the levels—each plant yields a different color of Light that can be forged into dyes. Use those dyes to add vibrant reds, greens, yellows, and more to your outfit, or mix them to create dozens of other colors to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/c6573f358cf2b72fbd7da2a803012c77c0d6d43e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Delight in a World of Color[/h2]
Experiment as colors become available with each Seasonal Quest, and you’ll be on your way to adding your own unique flair to your favorite outfits. Bold jewel tones, peaceful pastels, rustic earth colors, cheerful carnival hues, dramatic goth shades—your avatar is truly your canvas! 

The dye feature can be used with existing items too: Many of your capes, pants, tunics, and more have dyeable areas for you to customize! Preview possible color combinations as you select your favorites. Once you’ve decided and dyed your design, you can save up to two dyed versions of an item with the “Outfit Styles” option.

Along with the Radiance Guide, three Spirits who first appeared during Season of Gratitude (Sky’s first Season!) will also be waiting to meet you. Each one teaches a new emote, which may have you dancing or cartwheeling for joy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/f92f856e1c239ab2a8f67b3a450bc42829ab1a1c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Seasonal Items to Make Your Own[/h2]
This Season’s Spirits bring hairstyles, outfits, capes, and more, not to mention an instrument. Feel free to keep things in their original color if you enjoy a more minimalist aesthetic, but the Spirits have designed them especially to be dyed, and we can’t wait to see the designs you create!

The Radiance Guide offers two Ultimate Gifts for Season Pass holders to unlock while the Season is active. They’ll bring a uniquely shaped cape, too, which can be unlocked with Hearts even after the Season ends—a memento to mark the opening of Aviary Village’s Dye Workshop! And, naturally, these can all be customized with your favorite dyes.

notes.title: Sky x Alice’s Wonderland Cafe: Adventure Full of Surprises
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/6f018eb25d8754b7f77acc988aa765782ce500da.jpg[/img]

Days of Feast will look curious this year, inviting you to fall (quite literally) into an all-new adventure: Sky x Alice’s Wonderland Cafe!


[h2]Follow Your Curiosity[/h2]
From December 23rd through January 12th, get ready for three weeks of whirlwind adventures! Inspired by the magic and mischief of a certain Wonderland tale, this year the Aviary Village Cafe is transformed into a holiday-themed fantastical tea party that you won’t want to miss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/7bf9f469788bf8fee8782a05ba50809644e21674.jpg[/img]

[h2]A Tiny Perspective, a Grand Adventure[/h2]
Your journey begins with a tumble—straight into the heart of the Wonderland Cafe! Here, everything is topsy-turvy: The teapots are towering, a handful of books is a veritable maze, and you? Well, let’s just say you’ll feel smaller than a teacup.

Follow a very harried Dark Crab into the cafe and meet event Spirits who may seem a bit… mad, but don’t let that fool you—they have some very important (and very fun) requests for you.

Join the Mad Hatter in a lively jam session, pour tea for guests at the grandest (and quirkiest) tea party, and navigate through all kinds of curious surprises. Need a break from so much excitement? The cafe is filled with cozy places where you can curl up for a nap, as a friendly manatee may be able to point out. There’s no shortage of fun and silliness waiting for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/46738acc9ce32d8f6ec905c201ad87939a1f0ddd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Explore Hidden Surprises[/h2]
Completing activities with Spirits in the Wonderland Cafe each day to gather Event Ticket Light, up to 5 Tickets’ worth each day. Plus, you can explore at your own pace to uncover 15 hidden snowflake-shaped Event Tickets scattered throughout the space, available during the entire event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/6c6907e343bef3728604cd963db44b35fdfed466.jpg[/img]

You can also unlock whimsical cosmetics in the event area or the in-game shop. From a stacked hat worthy of Wonderland, to a teacup bathtub, even a charming yellow dress inspired by Alice’s classic look, there’s something for every Sky kid looking to carry part of Wonderland with them.

One of the most magical items? The Wonderland Cafe Corridor prop—a portal back to the Wonderland Cafe that you and nearby Sky kids can use. It’s perfect for revisiting this tiny-but-grand adventure anytime you’d like! Even after the event ends, you’ll find the Wonderland Hare Hairstyle available to unlock in the Wonderland Cafe (however, the other items debuting with this event will be available only during Sky x Alice’s Wonderland Cafe and are not currently scheduled to return in the future).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/24d74941f4a93238a0404cffad4660e073d498e1.jpg[/img]

And it wouldn’t be the holidays without spending time with loved ones—keep an eye out for someone very dear, and perhaps a bit like family, who might just stop by for a spot of tea.


[h2]New Adventures, Beloved Traditions[/h2]
Don’t forget about other Days of Feast traditions! The Secret Area accessible from the Vault of Knowledge opens its doors to everyone, and you’ll find freshly fallen snow in a realm known more for its lush summery green. 

If you want your avatar to experience a snowy transformation of its own, keep watch in the Village of Dreams for a Spirit who you might say is more of a hermit. Perhaps it’s the elevation change, but they do get a bit sneezy when they come down from the mountain side, and who knows what will happen if you stand close by…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/658477f6d1657d83aaef7e5b15f5e53f1337aeef.jpg[/img]

Sky x Alice’s Wonderland Cafe opens the door to fantastical surprises, all-new perspectives, and classic celebrations with friends and Spirits. When the magic arrives on December 23rd, join the adventure and make memories worthy of any storybook. We’ll see you in the skies!
